Mutation in ATP7A (Cu-transporting ATPase in intestinal and placental cells)
(X-linked recessive)

Mutation in ATP7B (Cu-transporting ATPase in hepatocytes)
(autosomal recessive, chromosome 13)

ATP7A loss → Cu trapped in enterocytes, not exported to blood
Copper deficiency in tissues (poor intestinal absorption)

Kinky/steely hair (pili torti)
Neurodegeneration, seizures
Hypotonia, failure to thrive

Kayser-Fleischer rings
Asterixis (flapping tremor)
Cirrhosis, hepatic failure
Neuropsychiatric: dysarthria, gait disturbance, personality change
Hemolytic anemia

↓ ceruloplasmin
↑ 24-hr urinary copper
↑ hepatic copper (liver biopsy)

Copper chelator D-penicillamine (first-line) or trientine
Zinc (blocks Cu absorption)
